text: Housekeeping: a sweep on the first request of a server run and about weekly, plus an integrity audit of every table

Landed in 1097e82. housekeeping.py: read-only audit() of 16 invariants in the order asked for, sweep() = gc.run then audit then the one repair, findings to the audit log as row ids only. Trigger moved from the single POST /sync call into a blueprint-scoped after_request hook: fires on the first request of a server run (boot-id trick) and about weekly, skips anonymous requests and a connection left mid-transaction, and swallows+logs every failure. shoppinglist audit CLI exits non-zero. meta.last_audit_at + server_runtime.audit_boot_id, migration 8. Server suite 460 -> 503; full gate green (server 503, web 406, Android). Two things the agent found beyond the brief: the sweep would have committed a failed request half-written work without the in_transaction guard (proved by mutation), and a close vote by a non-member of a tombstoned list is unreachable rather than a documented lingering state, so that comment was corrected.
